## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-5008. The issue is that ledger-queue-0 cannot reschedule because its local PersistentVolume has node affinity constraints bound to the failed node (ip-10-0-7-21). Local storage volumes cannot be accessed from other nodes, so manual intervention is required to either update the PV's node affinity to a healthy node with local storage, or provision new local storage and update the volume references. I provided the team with a step-by-step recovery procedure to get the Redis pod running on a healthy node before the 15:00 deadline.
